title: Four Clues on Linden Street (린든 거리의 네 가지 단서)

scenes.title: 동쪽으로 스무 걸음
scenes.summary: Outside the courtyard gate on Linden Street, Hannah, Arthur, and Caleb check the brass compass and count twenty paces east toward the stone fountain.

scenes.title: 돌 분수대 곁에서
scenes.summary: At the neighborhood stone fountain, Hannah and Caleb spot a carved leaf pointing toward the clock tower, but Arthur insists on taking a back-lane shortcut.

scenes.title: 유명한 지름길
scenes.summary: After three confident left turns, Arthur leads the group straight back outside Tessa's open cafe kitchen window at Linden Courtyard.

scenes.title: 시계탑의 그림자
scenes.summary: Joined by Owen at the municipal clock tower at noon, Hannah and Caleb watch the tower shadow point straight to a carved compass stone.

scenes.title: 헌책방 돌 아치 아래에서
scenes.summary: Meeting Evelyn under the stone arch of the second-hand bookshop, Hannah spots the green lending shelf in Card Three, making Evelyn gasp as she remembers the botanical book in Room 4.

scenes.title: 그늘진 공원 벤치
scenes.summary: At the shaded public garden bench at the end of Linden Street, Caleb places all four square cards together to reveal a bird-eye map of Linden Courtyard with a red star on the upper balcony.

scenes.title: 작은 편지 봉투를 열며
scenes.summary: On the park bench, Hannah, Evelyn, and Caleb break the wax seal and read the mapmaker's promise to return for Saturday tea thirty summers later.

scenes.title: 프런트 데스크에 도착한 소식
scenes.summary: Returning briskly to the front desk, Hannah and Arthur find Graham holding an express station message announcing the retired mapmaker arrives next Saturday evening.
